text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco and Libya agree to increase trade to $400 million and to set up a joint-venture to manufacture cars.
- Businessmen group meets govenment officials to assess cooperation between the business community and the authorities to spur development.
- Andre Azoulay, the king's economic adviser, meets a Malaysian business delegation.
- Petrol station owners threaten to strike on April 16.
- A French drug trafficker was arrested Morocco, smashing smuggling network in Spain and Morocco.
